mapper.sql: id, user_id, started_at, ended_at, wall_duration_seconds, reserved_seconds, stopped_by_cap, transcript, transcript_saved, material_snapshot
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voice_practice_session (user_id, started_at, wall_duration_seconds, reserved_seconds, stopped_by_cap, transcript_saved, material_snapshot) VALUES (#{userId}, #{startedAt}, 0, #{reservedSeconds}, 0, 0, #{materialSnapshot})
mapper.update: UPDATE voice_practice_session SET ended_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, reserved_seconds, started_at), wall_duration_seconds = reserved_seconds, stopped_by_cap = 1 WHERE ended_at IS NULL AND TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, reserved_seconds, started_at) <= #{now}

UPDATE voice_practice_session SET ended_at = #{endedAt}, wall_duration_seconds = 0, reserved_seconds = 0, stopped_by_cap = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND ended_at IS NULL AND transcript_saved = 0
